besluite.fout: 'robot' is the form the project's protected list rejects for a traffic light (HOU verkeerslig, NIE robot).
besluite.rede: The change brings in the protected word and removes the forbidden one, with the same place and scene.

besluite.fout: 'n Kind in een motor' copies English 'a child in one car' and reads stiffly.
besluite.rede: 'In een van die motors' is the natural Afrikaans way to pick one car out of the passing traffic, and the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'wat hy het, kan doen' invites a first misreading as 'what he has can do'.
besluite.rede: Repeating 'wat hy' removes the stumble and keeps the same three things, at a cost a Grade 6 reader can easily carry.
'Daaroor' points to 'menswaardigheid', the last word of the sentence just before, so it is clear, and the proposal repeats the term in two consecutive sentences.
Present tense in a clause describing what a story is about (''n storie van 'n man wat ... lê') is natural Afrikaans, so this is only a change of the story's tense.

besluite.fout: 'het gestop' leans on English where Afrikaans says a traveller 'hou stil'.
besluite.rede: 'Het stilgehou' is the more exact Afrikaans verb for the same action, with the same person and order.
'Ook ekstra' keeps the sense that this giving is in addition to the duty, without the doubling.

besluite.fout: 'n mens ... die mens voor hom' uses 'mens' in two senses in one short sentence, which is clumsy.
besluite.rede: 'Persoon' removes the clash and echoes 'die ander persoon' in the sentence before, without touching the protected 'Party Hindoes verduidelik dit'.

besluite.fout: The quoted saying after the colon has no quotation marks, unlike the Bible quotation earlier, and opens with an apostrophe that blurs where it starts.
besluite.rede: Quotation marks only mark the saying as a quotation; the words, and the ubuntu definition, are unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'goeie dinge vir ander toewens' bends the fixed construction 'iemand iets toewens'.
besluite.rede: The proposal uses the standard construction with the person as direct object, and 'ander mense' means the same as 'ander'.

besluite.fout: A comma stands before 'en' where 'en dan aan vreemdelinge' has no subject and verb of its own, against the AWS 2017 rule the project follows.
besluite.rede: Only the comma goes; the protected wording 'Hulle dink eers aan hulself en mense naby hulle' stays intact word for word, and 'eers ... en dan' still carries the order.

besluite.fout: 'waarheen ... welkom is' joins a direction word to a state.
besluite.rede: 'Waar enige kind welkom is' is the natural relative, and in both versions any child is welcome at the classes.

besluite.fout: 'saam leer' is written apart, though 'saam' with a verb is written as one word.
besluite.rede: 'Saamleer' is the correct compound spelling, matching 'saamspeel' later in the lesson.
